title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Locomotion 013 — Stride-Phase Airborne Handoff Repair
principle: AIRBORNE HANDOFF CONTINUES THE STRIDE CLOCK; IT DOES NOT START A JUMP CLOCK.

source.identity: Mario & Luigi — Super Mario Bros. 3 — NES
source.rights_boundary: Commercial sprite art is evidence only: no source pixels, palette, contours, costume, proportions, sheet layout, frame arrangement, tracing, choreography, redistribution, audio or close imitation enters output.

OBSERVED_INHERITED: TSR asset identity and complete 522×1878 playable-character sheet evidence family with walk/run movement families.
Static sheet does not establish source-authentic decisive-key exposure timing.
INFERRED: All successor ASCII geometry, support ownership, grounded-airborne phase relation, root/COM arc, landing/recovery causality, bridge geometry and timing.
UNKNOWN: Source-authentic exposure cadence, exact engine roots/chronology/force distribution.

keys.name: COMMITTED_R_STRIDE_ENTRY
keys.causal_role: enter already carrying forward stride debt; right foot owns root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root enters low and forward; no neutral pre-roll
keys.attitude: forward-hungry torso, left arm back, free leg already behind

keys.name: LEFT_KNEE_DRIVE
keys.causal_role: free-side knee crosses forward while trusted right foot keeps phase ownership
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root advances past old midline without losing right-foot support
keys.attitude: left knee punches ahead; shoulders counter-rotate instead of mirroring

keys.name: TAKEOFF_COIL_R
keys.causal_role: author braking-like vertical load before takeoff; support remains the same right foot
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drops while still advancing; stored lift is visible before support break
keys.attitude: compressed diagonal coil, free knee high, right hip loaded, arms wound asymmetrically

keys.name: TOE_DRIVE_R
keys.causal_role: right toe extends the body into flight; support break has not happened yet
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rebounds up-forward from the loaded foot; this key earns release
keys.attitude: long toe-to-head spear with free knee and opposite arm leading

keys.name: SUPPORT_BREAK_R
keys.causal_role: support is gone only after the authored toe drive; prior stride momentum continues
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root leaves ground on a forward-rise tangent rather than switching to a jump icon
keys.attitude: free leg stays ahead, takeoff leg trails; arms continue counter-swing

keys.name: AIRBORNE_STRIDE_CROSS
keys.causal_role: airborne task phase continues the gait clock: lead leg opens while takeoff leg trails
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root keeps accelerating forward while vertical speed bleeds toward apex
keys.attitude: wide scissor and shoulder counter-shear; not a symmetrical tuck

keys.name: APEX_PHASE_CONTINUE
keys.causal_role: apex changes vertical velocity, not the stride phase clock
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches apex while horizontal travel remains committed
keys.attitude: left-leading stride remains readable; torso twists against leg scissor instead of resetting

keys.name: DESCENT_OPEN_L
keys.causal_role: left side lengthens toward future support while right leg folds behind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root begins descent without slowing horizontal travel into a hover
keys.attitude: landing leg opens early; arms shear opposite the pelvis to manage descent

keys.name: LEFT_PRECONTACT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left foot nears the ground but does not own root; body prepares for impact before contact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root descends forward over an untrusted reaching foot
keys.attitude: left leg nearly straight; torso and rear arm hang back to create catch debt

keys.name: LEFT_FIRST_CONTACT
keys.causal_role: left foot first contact acquires support while root still outruns it
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact arrests vertical fall before it arrests forward travel
keys.attitude: high-forward pelvis over a long catching leg; upper body still carries flight lag

keys.name: LAND_CRUSH_LEFT
keys.causal_role: trusted left support absorbs inherited fall and forward velocity; compression spirals rather than collapsing into a symmetric skid icon
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drops and moves beyond first contact instead of snapping onto the foot
keys.attitude: one-leg crash spiral: support-side arm falls forward while free-side arm whips high-back; rear leg buckles late

keys.name: RIGHT_LEG_RECOVERY_SWING
keys.causal_role: left support remains truthful while the airborne right leg sweeps through for the next gait phase
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rebounds slightly but does not return to pre-jump height or cadence
keys.attitude: right knee attacks forward; impact-side arm lags behind the recovering torso

keys.name: RIGHT_GROUND_PROBE
keys.causal_role: right foot touches ahead as a probe; left support still owns root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root crosses between supports before ownership transfer
keys.attitude: long split stance with torso already turning toward the next step

keys.name: RIGHT_SUPPORT_ACQUIRE
keys.causal_role: right foot becomes trustworthy before left release; landing phase hands back into stride without clock reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root settles between two supports while ownership transfers
keys.attitude: wide asymmetric brace: right hip accepts load while left leg is still long

keys.name: LEFT_RELEASE_R_REBIND
keys.causal_role: left foot releases only after right support owns root; stride clock is rebound, not restart
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises and reaccelerates from the new support while left leg trails
keys.attitude: torso over-rotates forward; left leg and old impact arm lag

keys.name: EXIT_WITH_RECOVERY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: leave on a continuing stride with the next left reach already underway; recovery debt survives the cut
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root keeps moving forward; no idle reset or centered neutral
keys.attitude: head and free leg pull out of frame while right support still drives

history.highest_value_visible_defect: LAND_CRUSH_LEFT arms formed a near-horizontal generic crossbar, weakening arrest causality.
history.correction: Mutate SAME 013 K10 into a one-support crash spiral: support-side arm down/forward, free-side arm high/back, head/chest behind pelvis, rear leg buckles late; preserve support/root/timing.

history.basis: Corrected actual 53-frame render inspected: committed right-support stride, load/toe drive, authored support break, asymmetric airborne scissor through apex, precontact NO_SUPPORT reach, left catch/crush, right probe/acquire, left release and non-idle exit debt; spacing/arc nonuniform; connectors invent no support event.

noodle_queen.basis: Specific forward-hungry stride; phase survives flight; costly asymmetric landing spiral; explicit probe/acquire rebind; secondary lag and displaced non-idle exit; not placeholder run/jump interpolation.
